mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dashboard_menu ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dashboard_menu (title, icon, link, parent_id, permission_code, sort_order, create_time, type) VALUES (#{title}, #{icon}, #{link}, #{parent_id}, #{permission_code}, #{sort_order}, NOW(), #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM dashboard_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parent_id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dashboard_menu WHERE link LIKE CONCAT(#{linkPrefix}, '%')
